description: You are a detection engineer at an enterprise SOC responding to a security incident. The Wazuh SIEM has been collecting real security events from the monitored environment. Your tasks: (1) Investigate the current alerts and security events in the Wazuh dashboard — examine the active alerts, identify which rules are most frequently firing, and determine the nature of the security events occurring in this environment; (2) Create a Wazuh correlation rule that uses frequency and timeframe-based detection (Wazuh's 'frequency' and 'timeframe' rule attributes with 'if_matched_sid') to escalate repeated occurrences of the same suspicious event type into a high-severity alert at level 13 or above; the correlation rule should reference an existing Wazuh rule that is actually firing in the environment; (3) Configure a Wazuh active response entry in ossec.conf that fires when your new correlation rule triggers; (4) Write an incident investigation report to /home/ga/Desktop/incident_report.txt documenting: which events and rule IDs you investigated, the correlation pattern you identified and implemented, the frequency/timeframe thresholds you chose and why, and what automated response you configured. The report must be at least 300 characters. Dashboard: admin/SecretPassword at https://localhost. API: wazuh-wui/MyS3cr37P450r.*- at https://localhost:55000.

metadata.description: Investigate real alerts, create correlation rule with frequency/timeframe, configure active response, write incident report
